server.query: What's the address of your RomM server? It starts with http:// or https://, such as https://romm.example.com
server.change_query: What's the new address of your RomM server? It's now {host}

bad_server.query: That isn't a server address RomM Sync can use. It starts with http:// or https:// and names the server, such as https://romm.example.com or http://192.168.1.5:8080.

options.query: What would you like to change?

unpair.query: Unpair this Pocket from RomM? Its device is deleted in RomM, and the RomM address and sign-in are deleted from the Pocket. The Pocket keeps its ID and its saves.

new_device.query: Pairing gave this Pocket a new device in RomM instead of the one it synced with before: that one was deleted in RomM, or {host} is a different RomM server. Pair as new device to sync with the new one, or unpair to delete it. Nothing is saved until you choose.

menu.query: What would you like to do?

log.not_a_pocket_card: This doesn't look like a Pocket's SD card: a Pocket's card has Cores, Assets and Platforms folders. Choose the Pocket's card in Pocket Sync, then start RomM Sync again.
log.pocket_id_unreadable: This Pocket's ID, in romm-sync/device.json on the card, can't be read. RomM Sync won't make a new one, because RomM would then see a different Pocket. Restore the file from a backup, or delete it to sync as a new Pocket.
log.pocket_id_mismatch: This Pocket's ID file, romm-sync/device.json on the card, doesn't match the format RomM Sync expects, so the run has stopped. RomM Sync won't make a new ID, because RomM would then see a different Pocket. Restore the file from a backup, or delete it to sync as a new Pocket.
log.pocket_id_not_saved: Couldn't save this Pocket's ID to the card.
log.server_file_unreadable: romm-sync/server.json on the card can't be read, so the run has stopped. Fix the problem below, then start RomM Sync again. Deleting the file works too, but it loses the sign-in and collection saved in it.
log.bad_saved_host: {host}, the address in romm-sync/server.json, isn't a server address RomM Sync can use.
log.server_file_not_saved: Couldn't save the server address to romm-sync/server.json on the card.
log.not_romm: {host} doesn't answer as a RomM server does (HTTP {status}). Check the address in Options.
log.romm_too_old: RomM Sync needs RomM 5.4 or newer, and {host} has {version}.
log.unexpected_answer: {host} gave an answer RomM Sync didn't expect (HTTP {status}).
log.sign_in_rejected: RomM didn't accept the sign-in saved in romm-sync/server.json: it expired, or this Pocket's device was deleted in RomM. This Pocket will pair with RomM again.
log.pairing: Approve this Pocket in RomM, on the page opening in your browser. The code is {code}.
log.pairing_link: If the page doesn't open, paste this link into your browser: {url}
log.pairing_expired: The code {code} expired before it was approved.
log.pairing_busy: RomM has had too many pairing attempts from this computer. Wait a minute, then connect again.
log.paired: This Pocket is paired with RomM.
log.new_device_cancelled: Nothing has changed on the Pocket. The new device stays in RomM, and Connect will ask about it again.
log.sign_in_not_saved: Couldn't save the sign-in to romm-sync/server.json on the card.
log.permissions_missing: RomM didn't allow everything RomM Sync asked for. Missing: {permissions}.
log.games_off: Syncing games is off: it needs {permissions}.
log.collection_off: Creating the Analogue Pocket collection is off: it needs {permissions}.
log.saves_off: Syncing saves is off: it needs {permissions}.
log.not_paired: This Pocket isn't paired: romm-sync/server.json has no address or no sign-in.
log.unpairing: Deleting this Pocket's device in RomM…
log.unpaired: This Pocket is unpaired. Its device is deleted in RomM, and the RomM address and sign-in are deleted from the Pocket.
log.unpair_rejected: RomM didn't accept this Pocket's sign-in, so the Pocket can't be unpaired. Nothing has changed on the Pocket. Check the server address. If the sign-in expired, connect to pair again, then unpair. If this Pocket's device was already deleted in RomM, delete romm-sync/server.json on the card.
log.unpair_not_allowed: RomM didn't let this Pocket delete its device: that needs {permissions}, which pairing didn't grant. Nothing has changed on the Pocket. Delete this Pocket's device in RomM, then delete romm-sync/server.json on the card.
log.unpair_no_device: RomM has no device with the ID in romm-sync/server.json for this sign-in, so the Pocket can't be unpaired. Nothing has changed on the Pocket. Delete this Pocket's device in RomM, then delete romm-sync/server.json on the card.
log.server_file_not_deleted: This Pocket's device is deleted in RomM, but romm-sync/server.json couldn't be deleted from the card. Delete it by hand.
